venue.name: Black Creek Studio Gallery
venue.description: Black Creek Studio Gallery is the Black Creek gallery studio of the painter Brian Scott, on the North Island Highway in the Comox Valley. The website listed for it no longer loads, on either the plain address or the www one, so nothing about opening times, visits or groups could be confirmed from the venue itself. Whether it takes a children's group of any kind is unknown.

gaps: DEAD SITE. Loaded in a real browser on 2026-09-07, both https://bscottfinearts.ca/ and https://www.bscottfinearts.ca/ return a WP Engine holding page titled 'Site Not Configured | 404 Not Found'. There is no venue content on the domain at all.

CACHE WARNING. A plain fetch of https://bscottfinearts.ca/ returns a full, healthy-looking Brian Scott Fine Arts home page with an address, phone number and email. The browser proves that page is not live. Any re-run that uses fetching alone will look successful and will produce a confident, unverifiable record. Nothing from that cached copy has been recorded here.

One web search was done to look for a replacement official domain. brianscottfinearts.com and bscottfinearts.com do not resolve. brianscottfineart.com resolves but is a squatted spam blog with no connection to the artist. No live official site was found.
No address could be verified from a live page, so there are no coordinates and the record cannot be mapped.
Nothing is known about price, youngest age welcomed, group size, notice needed to book, lunch space, washrooms or rain backup.

The cached page showed no children's programme of any kind. It described a commercial gallery selling originals, prints, books and sculptures, plus a 'Learn with Brian' section about painting techniques whose own page returns nothing. That is a reason to expect little here, but it is not evidence, and no 'Group visit' programme has been invented.

Suggested next step is a phone call. The gallery has been reachable on a Black Creek number in the past. Recorded here as unverified rather than as a fact, because it comes from the cached copy: 8269 North Island Highway, Black Creek, BC V9J 1H4, telephone 250 337 1941.
